detail.longDescription: Congress MUST save science‼️ America’s scientific future depends on what Congress does next - Congress should fund extensions to fellowships and training grants, bridge support for early-career laboratories and opportunities for displaced researchers to resume their work. Agencies should extend eligibility windows for career development awards, and universities should adjust promotion timelines and protect trainees. Researchers should not lose their next opportunity because of interruptions imposed on them. Recovery also requires welcoming scientists from around the world. The federal government must provide predictable visa processes, and research institutions must sustain international collaboration...Congress must put lasting protections for scientific independence into law. Suspending, terminating or withholding awards should require documented grounds tied to published criteria and timely access to independent review. # science # research # academia # HigherEd # universities https:// thehill.com/opinion/congress-b log/technology/6201574-congress-restores-scientific-funding/
